observations.evidence: The lake has an irregular, asymmetric lobed outline, with small bays and narrowed sections. It is embedded in the surrounding forest and three attached channels.

The closer oblique view shows continuous water at all three observed channel-to-lake intersections. No obvious dry bar, floating ribbon, rectangular receiving patch or abrupt water-surface step is visible there.

The bank view shows quiet, gently disturbed reflections of the stylized trees, muted green water and subtle shallow-water detail. The lake reads calmer than the flowing channels and fits the painted landscape.

limitations: The restored lake inlet reaches remain quite straight, with conspicuous dark dry-looking headwater terminal bowls in the overview. These existing lake-inlet/source shapes are distinct from the corrected broad-main source geometry.

Regular ribbing or stepped bank patterns remain visible along the small channels. This addendum confirms restoration/contact and calm lake styling rather than a full naturalism pass for those legacy inlet shapes.
The original Bank height preset was obstructed by a foreground tree. A reversible horizontal orbit cleared it; the saved bank image is that adjusted low shore view.
